title: The Feelings Vault
old_caption:
Scorpio keeps feelings in a vault. Heart found the key.
"I like you. A normal amount." Very cool, very normal. Have you ever played it this cool?

title: Date Three, Big Trip
old_caption:
Date three and Sagittarius already had ten cities on the map.
Brain folded it down to one picnic by the lake. What is your ideal date-three plan?

title: Love, 15 Minutes
old_caption:
Capricorn penciled in love for Tuesday, 7:15 to 7:30, agenda attached.
Heart cleared the whole evening. Tag the friend who needs to hear this.

title: "lol cool"
old_caption:
Brain typed "lol cool maybe." Heart typed six exclamation marks.
Aquarius landed on "I'd really like that." Are you team chill or team caps lock?

title: The 12-Second Video
old_caption:
Inside Pisces' head during a twelve-second puppy video. Brain held an umbrella. It did not help.
What is the smallest thing that has ever made you cry?

title: "So... What Are We?"
old_caption:
Four months of "just hanging out." Taurus finally pressed the big button.
The answer was the easy part. Have you ever asked the question first?

title: Single at the Dinner
old_caption:
"So, seeing anyone?" Brain had excuses ready. Heart had a sign.
Leo went with the truth: the best year yet. Who is getting this question at dinner this month?

title: The Old Chat at 2 A.M.
old_caption:
2:14 a.m., scrolling back through an old chat for just one more message.
Brain plugged in the phone and tucked Heart in with a sock. Heart is already sneaking back. Relatable?

title: The Whole First Date
old_caption:
A whole first date, scored round by round. Brain brought a list of safe topics. Heart brought nothing but hope and one very long story.
The stars kept score and called it fair. Stay for the final round.

title: Left on Read: The Whole Evening
old_caption:
One message left on read and a whole evening of theories. Brain built a timeline. Heart wrote three drafts and deleted all of them.
The answer at the end is the most ordinary thing in the world. It usually is.
